source_name: Ceny Hospodářských novin – Nejlepší banka a Nejlepší pojišťovna (nejbanka.hn.cz)
why_relevant: The Hospodářské noviny bank award referenced in the cell brief. Results pages give a dated ranking of CZ banks/insurers with category detail; the surrounding HN/Economia event apparatus supplies speaker and partner rosters. Useful as a second, independently-juried view alongside Banka roku.

source_name: Konference IT ve finančnictví (financnictvi.konference.cz) – program, speakers, exhibitor stands
why_relevant: Long-running CZ conference whose audience is explicitly banks, insurers and financial institutions, with a published speaker page and exhibitor booths in the foyer. The /prednasejici page pairs named bank executives with named vendor executives — the de-facto partnership disclosure the cell rationale targets. Archive pages per year (e.g. /it-ve-financnictvi-2021) allow longitudinal vendor tracking.

source_name: Fintech Week CEE – Prague Edition (fintechweekcee.com)
source_subtype: conference week hub – sponsor/partner and agenda pages
why_relevant: New unified CEE fintech week (8-15 May 2026, Prague): four flagship conferences, two hackathons and 20+ side events. Named main partners already include Komerční banka, Visa with Flowpay, and the CzechInvest Fintech Regulatory Sandbox; Mastercard backs one hackathon. This is the highest-signal single page for who is paying to reach Czech/CEE banking buyers in 2026.

source_name: ETHPrague conference & hackathon (ethprague.com)
why_relevant: 5th edition 8-10 May 2026 at Obecní dům, anchoring Fintech Week CEE's opening hackathon; its sponsor tiers reveal digital-asset infrastructure vendors courting CZ banks, and Komerční banka runs a closed-door Crypto & Banking Day in the same window. Sponsor pages are the crypto-adjacent complement to the classic banking-conference lists.

source_name: FinTech Cowboys (fintechcowboys.cz)
why_relevant: CZ fintech media/community that both organises events and reports on other people's events, routinely naming panel line-ups down to individual bank and vendor participants (e.g. its digital-assets conference listing HAVEL & PARTNERS, Air Bank, Depo Ventures, KB SmartSolutions, SoftVision, Blockmate, Coinmate, InvestBay, plus ČNB and NBS regulators). Best single Czech-language pointer for discovering events this cell does not yet know about.

source_name: Tuesday Business Network – FIN (R)Evoluce conference page
why_relevant: 11th edition (Feb 2025, Hotel Jalta Prague) with an explicitly published partner list — EFG CZ, Salesforce, SOFTEC — and media partners Cardmag, CFOworld, Euro.cz, Ekonomický magazín, Finance.cz, SBK. Small, cheap-to-monitor page that names the exact vendor set courting CZ financial institutions on AI and new payment methods.

source_name: IT pro Finance (CAFIN) – conference, partner booths, past editions archive
why_relevant: 12th edition drew 150+ finance/controlling/IT professionals; 2026 edition 22 Oct at Grandior Hotel Prague on 'Technology, automation and AI'. Explicit partner-booth format in the foyer plus a /historie/ and /jiz-probehlo archive make it a longitudinal record of which finance-IT vendors buy access to Czech CFO/bank-ops buyers.

source_name: MoneyExpo Praha / Profi MoneyExpo (money-expo.cz)
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. Trading/investing expo organised by Financial Progress Group a.s. with an exhibitor floor; the separate profi.money-expo.cz B2B track is where brokers, payment providers and platform vendors exhibit. Exhibitor lists are a snapshot of retail-investment and payments vendors selling into CZ.

source_name: MoneyFest (moneyfest.cz) + Cubex venue event page
why_relevant: Czech finance conference with an explicit expo zone of ~35 curated exhibitors; the venue's own event page (cubexcentrum.cz) sometimes exposes exhibitor/partner detail the organiser page omits. Good mid-tier read on advisory/insurance/fintech vendors targeting CZ distribution.

source_name: Colors of Finance (colors-of-finance.cz), Ostrava
why_relevant: Self-described largest Czech finance & networking conference, held outside Prague (Ostrava, 7 Oct 2026). Regional events surface distribution-side and mid-market vendors that never appear on Prague sponsor lists — useful for completeness of the CZ vendor map.

source_name: Money20/20 Europe – official sponsor directory
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. 220+ signed sponsors, 8,000+ attendees, 90+ countries (RAI Amsterdam, 3-5 June 2026; 2027 edition 8-10 June). Filtering the sponsor/exhibitor directory for CZ/CEE-headquartered firms and for global vendors with CZ bank references identifies who is investing in reaching this region at the top of the funnel.

source_name: Seamless Europe (payments/fintech/banking expo, Munich) – LinkedIn and event presence
source_subtype: international expo – exhibitor/speaker roster (via social index)
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief as a delegation target. ~5,000 attendees, 400 speakers, 200 exhibitors (10-11 Sept, Messe Munich). Its exhibitor roster is the nearest large European payments floor to CZ vendors and a plausible venue for CZ delegations; the LinkedIn page is the reliably reachable index while the canonical event domain was not confirmed in this pass.

source_name: CzechTrade – Czech fintech delegations and Czech Fintech Industry catalogue
why_relevant: State export agency organises and then publicly reports CZ fintech delegations to CEE markets (Budapest, 10-11 June 2026), naming the participating companies (e.g. Citfin, Comgate) and the host banks/investors met. It also publishes a Czech fintech industry catalogue PDF — effectively an official, vetted vendor roster for the cell's actor map.

source_name: Mastercard Newsroom CZ – annual Czech payment-sector awards
why_relevant: Scheme-run awards name which CZ issuers/acquirers shipped which innovation in the past year (2025: ČSOB, Air Bank, Raiffeisenbank most awards; gaming cards, tap-to-phone terminal). Because a scheme only awards implementations it certified, these releases are unusually reliable implementation evidence and often the first public naming of a delivery partner.

source_name: Visa Awards CZ – annual Czech payments awards (press coverage cluster)
why_relevant: Visa's CZ awards ceremony (Signal Space gallery, Prague) hands out category prizes that read as a market share and implementation map: Partners Banka for best Visa-as-a-Service implementation, wFlow for New Flows, Raiffeisenbank #1 Issuer, Global Payments #1 Acquirer, plus Fio, KB, Česká spořitelna, mBank. Extremely dense partnership/vendor signal; only reachable via the press-release cluster since no standalone award site was found.

source_name: Zlatá koruna – financial product awards (Finanční akademie)
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. Long-running (23rd edition) product-level award judged by a ~350-member Finanční akademie across ~24 categories, under Ministry of Finance and ČNB patronage. Category-level winners (e.g. MONETA Smart Banka as banking product of the year, Česká spořitelna in Payment cards / Online applications) identify which digital implementations the market rates — a direct feed into case-study discovery. The canonical award domain was not confirmed in this pass, so the reachable entry point is the press-release cluster.

source_name: Finparáda – Finanční produkty roku
why_relevant: A third, methodologically distinct CZ product award (run by the Finparáda comparison site) covering savings, accounts, loans and investments. Its rankings are a useful triangulation against Zlatá koruna and Banka roku, and its category set changes with market fashion (a leading indicator of product-area competition).

source_name: Časopis Bankovnictví (bankovnictvionline.cz) – event and award reporting
why_relevant: The CZ banking trade magazine covers conferences (e.g. 'Svět IT ve finančnictví láká na technologické inovace') and award results, frequently naming speakers, sponsors and the technologies pitched. Best single Czech-language pointer for discovering banking-sector events and their line-ups without depending on each organiser's site staying up.

source_name: SystemOnline – kalendář akcí (IT/finance event calendar)
why_relevant: A Czech enterprise-IT portal that maintains a structured event calendar including financial-sector IT conferences, and reports on them. Cheap, structured discovery layer for events this cell has not yet enumerated — feed it into the actor map before each conference season.

source_name: Economia events portal (events.economia.cz)
why_relevant: Economia (publisher of HN, Ekonom) runs a steady stream of paid banking/payments events — e.g. 'Inovace v platebních kartách'. Each event page carries a programme and partner block, and the publisher's commercial interest means the partner list is complete and dated. Also the organiser side of the HN bank awards.

source_name: ČNB Národní fórum pro platby (National Payments Forum)
why_relevant: Not a conference in the commercial sense, but a regulator-convened standing forum (launched June 2026) on instant payments and fraud, with a published membership of banks, PSPs and other stakeholders plus meeting materials. Membership rosters and agendas are the highest-credibility 'who is in the room' list in CZ payments and complement the paid sponsor lists.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (cbaonline.cz) – conferences and member communications
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. The banking association (34 members, >99% of the CZ banking sector) explicitly treats conferences and media cooperation as a core communication channel. Its event pages and member list are the canonical actor map for the demand side that all vendor sponsorship targets.

source_name: KB SmartSolutions (kbsmart.cz) – bank fintech venture arm
why_relevant: Komerční banka's autonomous fintech vehicle, described as the CZ leader in bank-fintech cooperation, and a recurring speaker presence at CZ conferences and panels (e.g. Patrik Nový on the digital-assets panel). Its portfolio/partner pages convert conference-stage appearances into confirmed commercial relationships — the natural verification layer for partnership signals harvested from agendas.

source_name: VŠE Prague – Fintech professional programme, financial laboratory and FinBank society
why_relevant: The cell's 'university-bank lab' vector. VŠE is building a financial laboratory and an accredited Fintech study programme (Faculty of Finance & Accounting with Faculty of Informatics & Statistics, funded under the National Recovery Plan), with framework cooperation agreements signed with partner companies and a documented UniCredit Bank teaching partnership; the student FinBank society brokers bank guest lectures. Corporate partner names on these pages are early, low-noise indicators of which vendors and banks are investing in the CZ talent pipeline.

source_name: Money Maker Praha (cc.cz) – business & investment conference
why_relevant: Run by CzechCrunch (10-11 Nov 2026, Výstaviště Praha, Průmyslový palác). CzechCrunch is also a heavyweight reporter on CZ fintech deals; its conference partner and speaker lists tie investor, bank and fintech actors together, and its editorial (e.g. the Fintech Week preview) is a reliable pointer to who is on which stage.

source_name: Jobs.cz (Alma Career CZ) – IT/banking job listings
why_relevant: Largest CZ job board; bank and integrator ads naming vendor products (Temenos, Mambu, Finastra, Adyen, Diebold Vynamic, Way4, OpenWay) are the earliest public proof of a live platform deployment or migration programme years before any case study or press release.

source_name: StartupJobs.cz – integration / payments developer listings
why_relevant: Czech startup/fintech job board where payment-gateway and integration roles name concrete stacks (GoPay, ComGate, Adyen, Stripe, Twisto/Skip Pay) and thereby reveal which PSP and acquiring integrations are being built by CZ fintechs and bank subsidiaries.

source_name: Prace.cz – IT vacancies (Prague/Informatika)
why_relevant: Second large CZ board (same group as Jobs.cz but distinct inventory, incl. staffing agencies and body-shops); agency ads for bank projects often leak the client's platform name even when the bank is anonymised.
